title: SwAV
paper_title: Unsupervised Learning of Visual Features by Contrasting Cluster Assignments
core_mech: 以在线平衡原型分配作为跨视图预测目标，区别于 BYOL 的 EMA 表示回归和 SimCLR 的实例负样本。
core_mech_en: Replaces pairwise instance comparisons with online Sinkhorn-Knopp balanced prototype cluster assignment and swapped cross-view prediction.
input_desc: 同一图像的两张全局裁剪和若干局部裁剪
input_en: 2 global high-resolution views + M small local crops of the same image
output_desc: 可迁移图像表示与在线 prototype 分配
output_en: Transferable visual backbone and online learnable prototype codebook

source.title: SwAV
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.
License conditions exceed this project's MIT grant. Keep this upstream source under its own terms; this registry does not vendor or relicense it.

adapter.name: SwAV
adapter.mechanism: Entropy-regularized balanced Sinkhorn assignments from one view supervise prototype scores in the other.
limitations: Small two-view experiment; no multi-crop queue/distributed training. Tiny batches are an objective exercise, not evidence of learned transfer.
